scientific_integrity: This is a mathematical claim proved using finite-dimensional spectral projectors and elementary analytic sign arguments. A finite numerical regression is supplementary only; no independent scientific audit has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Only connected complete signed networks with disjoint internally homogeneous negative blocks, unit positive between-block conductance, and strictly positive complementary eigenvalues. Asymptotic error constants are not uniform over network size; uniqueness in all literature is not established.
title: Fractional Markovian repair and sharp positivity horizons for antagonistic complete networks
